summary: Iter319 — Permintaan Desain ↔ Design Studio sync: 9/9 backend tests passed (1 skipped, non-critical) covering /design-requests/meta categories, POST create with new pattern+design categories (invalid → 400), designer create-design (in_progress, code SRI-SLR-AO-###), studio submit → request delivered, admin approve/reject on studio-linked request → 400, studio request-revision (revision_count++, reject_reason), studio approve → approved, link-design happy path + already-linked guard, list envelope contains designs[] & studio_linked. Frontend admin+designer flows verified: 7 columns render, create modal (3 numbered sections) fills via KNSelect (SLR/AO), assignee user_designer_01, brief validation works, new card appears; designer detail shows dsr-stepper + dsr-linked-designs (empty), dsr-new-design-title prefilled from brief, dsr-create-design-button navigates to design-detail-page with chip 'Dari permintaan KSC/DSR-00016 — status permintaan mengikuti desain ini' and code SRI-SLR-AO-005; designer upload+submit moves request to Menunggu Keputusan; admin detail shows dsr-decide-in-studio + dsr-open-studio-button (no dsr-approve-button) — opening it navigates to design detail with Setujui (ACC) modal + score picker. Regressions OK: rnd-designs cards+create button, logistics dashboard.
action_items: (minor/optional) Score buttons in Design Studio ACC modal are individual buttons (0, 0.25, ... 2). Consider standardising data-testid per value like design-action-score-1.75 for easier automation; currently the container has data-testid=design-action-score but children lack values-in-testid.
critical_code_review_comments: design_request_service.attach_designs is called on each list request; consider caching or batching if list volume grows. For now performance is fine.
